question.text: <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>1</mn></math> mol of an octahedral metal complex with formula <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msub><mi>MCl</mi><mn>3</mn></msub><mo>·</mo><mn>2</mn><mo> </mo><mi mathvariant="normal">L</mi></math> on reaction with excess of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msub><mi>AgNO</mi><mn>3</mn></msub></math> gives <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>1</mn><mo> </mo><mi>mol</mi></math> of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>AgCl</mi><mo>.</mo></math> The denticity of Ligand <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi mathvariant="normal">L</mi></math> is___________ (Integer answer)

solution.text:
As 1 mole complex give 1 mole mole AgCl precipitate. So only one Cl ion is in ionisation sphere.

As complex is octahedral so denticity of Ligand L is =2.
